study type: Case-control study (CMPA diagnosis) and Prospective cohort study (formula supplementation)
cohort: Two groups: 1) 55 CMPA-diagnosed children and 55 milk-tolerant controls, 2) 179 breastfeeding mothers.
finding: Breastfed infants given formula supplements within 24 hours of life were significantly more likely to develop CMPA compared to exclusively breastfed infants, even after controlling for parental atopy and infant sex.
